question: The cardiothoracic ratio threshold of less than 0.5 for normal cardiac size can be applied to both PA and AP chest radiographs interchangeably.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. The CTR <0.5 threshold is valid ONLY on PA films. AP films — which are standard for portable and ICU radiographs — magnify the cardiac silhouette because the X-ray beam diverges before reaching the detector. Applying the <0.5 rule to an AP film will lead to overcalling cardiomegaly.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. The CTR <0.5 rule applies ONLY to PA (postero-anterior) films. AP films place the X-ray source anteriorly, which magnifies the cardiac shadow and systematically produces a higher CTR, making the <0.5 threshold unreliable for AP projections.
